content:
nina (acct): ArgusBank sent an RFP. They want a 10-day POC, on-prem/private deploy, FIPS HSM, and committed pricing tiers. Asking also for an exec one-pager capability matrix and a short legal-friendly key custody blurb. Can we triage?

harry (solutions): Quick triage: POC scope ok. Blockers: need NDA before access, need their HSM model + network topology, and clarify SLO targets (they asked p95 <60ms for short chat).

lee (eng): p95 <60ms for 32 tokens doable with dedicated A10s or our appliance. Need their expected peak RPS. HSM: we support KMIP & CloudHSM; on-prem HSM needs a connector and ports open to the HSM appliance.

ruta (sec): Security question: Key custody for Private? We default to customer-managed keys on Private; we'll provide standard language: "Customer retains sole custody of keys; Redwood stores encrypted references only." Will add to RFI.

harry (solutions): I'll draft the capability matrix: model rows (redwood-13B/70B), quant, latency p95, throughput/GPU, cost estimates. Also add a conservative POC price (40% off list for 2 weeks).

nina (acct): Great. Can someone list the exact infra artifacts we need from the bank to include in the handoff?

lee (eng): HSM vendor+model+firmware, VPC CIDRs, allowed egress, preferred region, expected QPS and prompt length distribution, point-of-contact for infra.

deploy-bot: Ticket #POC-5902 created and assigned to harry, lee, rita. Due date 2024-11-09.

harry (solutions): I'll drop a draft RFI appendix and a one-page capability PDF by EOD. Nina, please request NDA + sample prompts + infra POC contact.

nina (acct): On it. Thanks everyone.
